title: Johnson & Johnson to Present 13 Abstracts Advancing Neurovascular Science at SVIN 2026
summary: Data from the MEMBRANE study and EXCELLENT registry expand the evidence base in chronic subdural hematoma and ischemic stroke
body_markdown:
**Irvine, CA – November 17, 2026** – Johnson & Johnson today announced that 13 abstracts, including four podium presentations, will be featured at the Society of Vascular and Interventional Neurology (SVIN) 20th Annual Meeting in Las Vegas, Nevada. These abstracts span clinical studies, prospective registries, and real-world evidence (RWE), and examine patient outcomes in chronic subdural hematoma (cSDH) and ischemic stroke, including cognitive and other long-term clinical outcomes.


A key focus of the scientific program is the evolving treatment landscape for cSDH, including middle meningeal artery embolization (MMAe). New analyses from the MEMBRANE study will explore important aspects of care for patients with cSDH and build on existing clinical data for TruFill n-BCA. These include an analysis of cognitive outcomes following MMAe, alongside additional investigations of treatment strategies and healthcare resource utilization.


“Rigorous clinical evidence is essential to answering the questions that matter most in neurovascular care,” said Christian Cuzick, Worldwide President, Neurovascular, Johnson & Johnson MedTech. “From cognitive outcomes after MMAe in chronic subdural hematoma to large-population clot analysis, the research we’re presenting at SVIN is designed to inform everyday practice and help move patient care forward.”


Beyond cSDH, the company will highlight research from the global EXCELLENT registry, a prospective study of 2,000 patients undergoing endovascular treatment for ischemic stroke with systematic clot analysis. Conducted across three continents, the registry examines differences in baseline characteristics, treatment practices, outcomes, and clot composition, contributing to a broader understanding of ischemic stroke management. The registry included first-line use of CEREGLIDE 71 and EMBOTRAP devices.


Key presentations include:


- **Late-Breaking Presentation:** *The impact of middle meningeal artery embolization (MMAe) on cognitive outcomes: MEMBRANE Trial Post-hoc Analysis.* Thursday, November 19. 10:30 a.m. PT, Dr. Fawaz Al-Muftii
- **E-Poster:** *TRUFILL n-BCA Middle Meningeal Artery Embolization from MEMBRANE Study: General Anesthesia versus Conscious Sedation* . Dr. Jieqing Wanii
- **Poster:** *TRUFILL n-BCA Middle Meningeal Artery Embolization from MEMBRANE Study: Healthcare Resource Utilization among Surgically-Treated Patients* . Wednesday, November 18. 8:00 a.m. PT, Dr. Charles C. Matoukiii
- **Oral Presentation:** *MEMBRANE: Middle Meningeal Artery Embolization for the Treatment of Subdural Hematomas with TRUFILL n-BCA – 12-Month Results.* Friday, November 20. 8:00 a.m. PT, Dr. Christopher Kellneriv
- **Oral Presentation:** *The EXCELLENT Registry: A 2,000-Patient Prospective Global Registry of Endovascular Stroke Treatment with Systematic Clot Analysis.* Friday, November 20. 8:00 a.m. PT, Dr. Raul Nogueirav


In addition to scientific presentations, Johnson & Johnson will support early-career physician education through the SVIN Fellows Course and SVIN–SLICE Masterclass. The company will also spotlight TRUFILL n-BCA and the CEREGLIDE portfolio through hands-on sessions, clinical exchange and expert engagement at the Johnson & Johnson booth.
